slides.title: Still stiff after a week?
slides.bubble:

An assessment comes first!
slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
By mid-afternoon Mr Turtle's upper back feels like a brick. The mid back is built to rotate and extend. Sit slightly slumped for a few hours and it simply stops doing either. That's stiffness, not damage.

Hybi's 2-minute loosener: arms crossed, turn to look behind you, 5 each way. Hands behind your head, lean gently back over the chair top, 10 slow reps. Wall angels, 10 reps. Two or three times a day, small range, no forcing.

Still stiff after a week or so? Hands-on treatment from a chiropractor can free up a stubborn segment so the exercises are easier to do well. It works alongside movement, not instead of it. Book online via the link in bio 🐢

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
